title: G6 8G transmitter always shows Initial Calibration
symptom: Restarting a G6 sensor with an 8G transmitter using the sensor's code causes the fly-out menu to always display 'Initial Calibration'. Calibrations do seem to take, however, but the user is not totally sure it's working correctly.
fix: You can ignore the messages. There is already work in progress to update xDrip to provide correct messages. You can use xDrip as is knowing what messages you can ignore.
evidence_quote: You can ignore the messages.  No, they still show up and have not been addressed yet.
